setup.title: Set up ConductLoop
setup.intro: What a healthy local-first second brain needs, checked live against this install. The optional ones are extras.
setup.channels_note: — talk to your agents from Telegram and get the results of finished runs there. Off until you turn it on.
setup.credentials_note: — every key this app holds, and where it keeps them. Paste a key there and it goes into the system keychain (or an encrypted file if there is none); the app never shows it again.
setup.library_intro: Folders ConductLoop reads and indexes every hour. It never writes to them: its own notes (daily briefing, agent notes, memory export) go to the folder below.
setup.index_folders_label: Note folders to index (one per line), e.g. your Obsidian vault
setup.map_folder_hint: Where the map is also written, so it travels with your notes: one file with everything, and one page per project with links your vault can follow. The agent's own workspace always gets it too.
setup.backups_intro: Copies of the app's database: your index, chats, agents, tasks and settings stored in the app. Taken once a day and before an update changes the database, and whenever you click below. Your notes folders are not in them: they stay where they are. The last 30 are kept.
setup.obsidian_intro: Transfer the Brain's memory to your Obsidian vault as markdown — it then travels with your notes (sync, backup, git). Export writes notes; Import reads edited notes back.
setup.map_intro: Your notes, ordered: which project each one belongs to, which ideas belong to nobody yet, and the projects your notes know about but the registry does not. This is what survives when you change agents.
setup.write_map: Write it where the next agent looks
setup.all_ready: All {n} required checks passed — you're ready. The optional ones are extras.
setup.write_vault_env: Set by an environment variable on this computer: it cannot be changed here.
setup.write_vault_missing: This folder does not exist yet: create it, or choose another.
setup.saved_folders: ✓ Saved. Click “Index now” to read them right away.
setup.indexing: Indexing… (new notes take a few seconds, the first run a little longer)
setup.picker_failed: ✗ The folder picker could not open: type the path.
setup.restore_confirm:
Restore the backup of {when}?

Everything stored in the app since then is replaced. The current database is backed up first, so you can go back to it.
setup.restored: ✓ Restored. The state before it is saved as a “pre-restore” backup.
setup.map_drift: Where your index and the vault disagree
setup.drift_missing: {n} project notes are in the vault but in no index: {names}
setup.drift_repeats: {n} note(s) contain a copy of themselves: {names}
setup.drift_wanted: {n} links point at notes you never wrote: {names}
setup.map_unlinked: Notes a project page does not link
setup.map_empty: No notes indexed yet. Point the folders above at your vault and press “Index now”.
setup.proposal_where: The nightly pass writes these, and everything else that fell out, into PROPOSAL.md in the agent's workspace.
setup.unplaced: {n} do not fit in any section ({names})
setup.new_section_title: The new section that would be created in the index
setup.orphans_detail: {title} — {n} note(s) in its folder that its page does not link: {names}
setup.put_in_index: Put the ticked ones in the index
setup.tick_first: Tick the ones you want first.
